exclusions: The red named 4th campus building lies on the south side of the lawn. The distinct bright rooflight and riverside glazed arcades of Gezhi Hall do not match source 320.
OSM gives start_date=1894; the university explicitly gives 1863, 1864, and repairs in 1899. The real marked 42nd building, shown as a separate OSM way, is not part of the geometry.
scale: The mapped two-storey core is approximately 26.6 by 15.7 m. The nominal site area in the campus archive is 754 square metres, and the frozen rectangular model is approximately 418 square metres. These measurements describe different extents. Only the southern frontage, projecting carriage porch, lookout and anterior roof are replaced; the northern part of source 320 remains.
